title: Dimension of a nonempty fixed-dimensional smooth scheme over a field
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X a nonempty scheme [def-pc-scheme], and g:X→Spec k a morphism smooth of relative dimension n∈ℕ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Then the topological Krull dimension of X [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] is n.
